summary: A compiled TikZ reconstruction exists (v1, best-scored at 0.86). It draws triangle A1B1M2 with the top side horizontal, sides A1M2 and B1M2, and a full circle centred at M2 passing through both sides. All three labels are present. Coordinates come from CV (A1 (79,48), B1 (276,48), M2 (178,221) px, circle radius 118 px). Later versions v2 (bold labels), v3 (r=3.25 cm) and v4 (r=3.17 cm) scored 0.84-0.85 and were not promoted.
